## preamble

### dependencies

```{r load-libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(spatialdataR)
library(SpatialData.plot)
library(magick)
```

```{r}
library(duckspatial)
library(duckdb)
conn <- duckdb::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
ddbs_install(conn, extension = "httpfs")
duckdb::dbDisconnect(conn)
```

```{r load-data}
zs <- "https://uk1s3.embassy.ebi.ac.uk/idr/zarr/v0.4/idr0052A/5514375.zarr"
lb <- file.path(zs, "labels")
(i <- readImage(zs) |> addCT(name="global"))

# label includes a superfluous 'c'hannel dimesions
# that currently causes issues with 'plotLabel()';
# we drop it here in a not-too-pretty way
l <- readLabel(file.path(lb, "Cell")) |> addCT(name="foo")
l@data <- lapply(l@data, \(.) { dim(.) <- dim(.)[-2]; . })
sf <- spatialdataR:::.get_ms_scale(l)
l@meta <- SpatialDataAttrs(type="label", dim=4)
l@meta[[1]]$multiscales[[1]]$datasets[[1]]$coordinateTransformations[[1]]$scale <- sf[-1]

(sd <- SpatialData(
    images=list(image=i),
    labels=list(cells=l)))
```

```{r}
pal <- c("cyan", "magenta", "black")
(ch <- channels(image(sd)))
```

```{r message=FALSE, results="hide"}
ax <- axes(image(sd), "name")
zi <- which(ax == "z")
nz <- dim(image(sd))[zi]-10
ps <- lapply(seq(2, nz, 2), \(z) {
    plotSpatialData(sd) + 
        labs(title=paste("z =", z)) +
        theme(legend.position="none") +
        plotImage(z=z, t=1, ch=ch, c=pal) +
        plotLabel(z=z, t=1, a=1/3, pal="yellow") +
        scalebar(len=10, xrel=0.9, yrel=0.9)
})

out_dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(out_dir)
png(file=file.path(out_dir, "z%02d.png"), width=300, height=300)
for (p in ps) print(p)
dev.off()

list.files(out_dir, full.names = TRUE) |>
    lapply(magick::image_read) |>
    do.call(c, args = _) |>
    magick::image_animate(fps=2) |>
    magick::image_write("z-video.gif")

unlink(out_dir, recursive=TRUE)
```

```{r message=FALSE, results="hide"}
ax <- axes(image(sd), "name")
ti <- which(ax == "t")
nt <- dim(image(sd))[ti]
ps <- lapply(seq(2, nt, 2), \(t) {
    plotSpatialData(sd) + 
        labs(title = paste("t =", t)) +
        theme(legend.position="none") +
        plotImage(z=10, t=t, ch=ch, c=pal) +
        plotLabel(z=10, t=t, a=1/3, pal="yellow") +
        scalebar(len=10, xrel=0.9, yrel=0.9)
})

out_dir <- tempfile()
dir.create(out_dir)
png(file=file.path(out_dir, "t%02d.png"), width=300, height=300)
for (p in ps) print(p)
dev.off()
 
list.files(out_dir, full.names = TRUE) |>
    lapply(magick::image_read) |>
    do.call(c, args = _) |>
    magick::image_animate(fps=2) |>
    magick::image_write("t-video.gif")

unlink(out_dir, recursive=TRUE)
```
